outgoing.name: Computer science
outgoing.excerpt: Donald Ervin Knuth ([knuːθ], born January 10, 1938) is a renowned computer scientist and professor emeritus at Stanford University.

outgoing.name: TeX
outgoing.excerpt: He is also the creator of the TeX typesetting system and of the METAFONT font design system, and pioneered the concept of literate programming.
